_what: How the mail screen lays out its verbs and every word it says about them. Titles and keys come from mail-commands.json (the command table); this file names each verb's icon, where it is drawn, and the choices behind the planning verbs. `card` is the row at the bottom of the open message, `card_more` its overflow menu; `bar` is the bar under the card, `bar_more` its overflow menu (a `null` entry draws a separator). `icon_tones` colours a verb's icon with a tone of the shared Icon (success, accent, error, info, muted); a verb not listed keeps the text colour. `durations` are the minutes the Set duration menu offers. `thread.most_messages` is how many of a conversation's latest messages the screen draws; Done and Delete act on the whole conversation. The planning verbs act on the one task that carries this email (calendar-tasks action from_source), so priority, time and deadline live where every other task's do.
